name: snipd
description: Connect Codex to your Snipd account: read, delete and tag your podcast snips and notes, browse and manage the shows and guests you follow, search what was said in podcasts, find people by name or bio, open episodes (AI details, AI summaries, transcripts), see your favorites, custom lists, history and what is trending, control your play queue, and upload your own audio or have text read aloud.

interface.longDescription: Snipd is a podcast app for learning: you save the best moments of episodes as snips, with notes. This plugin brings that knowledge into your agent so you can put it to work. Review and organize your snips with tags, pull quotes and key takeaways into your notes and writing, search what was said in podcasts on any topic, and get the AI summary or transcript of an episode instead of listening to all of it. Keep on top of the shows and guests you follow, your favorites, custom lists and listen history, and line up what to hear next in your play queue; your devices pick the changes up. You can also upload audio files and YouTube videos into your Snipd library, and turn text such as a web article into a private episode read aloud (text-to-speech). Signs in with your Snipd account. Changes to your account (deleting or tagging snips, following, favorites, the play queue, uploads) are only made after you confirm them.
capabilities: Search moments in your subscriptions and listen history
Find people by name or bio
Open episodes: details, transcripts and AI snips
See your feeds and listen history
Upload audio files and YouTube videos
